{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify the sentinel value row
sentinel_baseline = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]

# Check the distribution of these sentinel rows across arms
print("Sentinel baseline by arm:\n", sentinel_baseline['arm'].value_counts())

# Check distribution across severity
print("Sentinel baseline by severity:\n", sentinel_baseline['severity'].value_counts())

# Check distribution across sex
print("Sentinel baseline by sex:\n", sentinel_baseline['sex'].value_counts())"}
